details:
In regards to the new "age assurance" system some question and issue came up

Even with the "age assurance" tag on a users profile please somewhere expose which version of verification they have used , some users might not trust a "age estimation" approach when wanting to make friends of the same age , users should have a right to see if a user is "Maybe 18+" or "Id verified 18+" , age estimation works and is a good thing to implement IF tools are being provided to be able to clearly differentiate between the two , a full "merge" to "Age assurance" will honestly create way more confusion between people as now they definitely wouldn't be able to trust a badge saying they are "probably an adult" 

Like i said estimation is a good thing for convenience of the user and data privacy , but we need to be able to differentiate between what system/s got used , this an easily accesible way to see the information within vrchat itself and on the website

I understand why the two would want to be merged into "Age Assurance" umbrella term , but like i stated above i do think this will result in confusion between users and will result in way more issues than it solves
title: Age Assurance Issues / Clarification
